headline: It starts at 3am. It never really stops.
body:
You're two weeks old and furious.
I come.

You're four. The monster's back.
I come, and I check twice.

You're sixteen and stuck at 1am.
I come, and I don't ask in the car.

You're thirty, up with your own.
I come, and I take a shift.

*Same answer at every age.*
*You'll never have to ask twice.*
